# xshield_work_request (Data Source)

The state of one asynchronous operation.

Mutating calls that do work in the background return a work request id in the `x-ct-workrequest-id` response header. Read it here to see whether that work finished.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Follow an asynchronous change through to completion.
data "xshield_work_request" "last_change" {
  id = "1f5ed7fa-f6dc-4b57-b963-0f26827662f8"
}

output "finished" {
  value = data.xshield_work_request.last_change.terminal
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Work request id, as returned in the x-ct-workrequest-id header.

### Read-Only

- `action` (String) What triggered the work, such as AssetUpdated or TemplateEdit.
- `completed_at` (String) When the work reached a terminal status, if it has.
- `created_at` (String)
- `resource_id` (String) Object the work applies to.
- `resource_name` (String)
- `retry_counter` (Number) How many times the work has been retried.
- `status` (String) One of Pending, InProgress, Retry, Completed, Cancelled or Superseded. Superseded means a later request for the same resource replaced this one.
- `subject` (String) Principal that submitted the work.
- `terminal` (Boolean) True once the status is one the work will not move on from.
